reviews.feedback: internal/api/team.go updateMember (about lines 84-90): the self-target check returns 403 before the last-owner check, so the sole owner PATCHing their own role gets 403 forbidden. The task says demoting the only owner is 409 last_owner 'also when the owner does it to themselves', which takes precedence over the general 'nobody changes their own role (403)' rule. Fix: decode the body first; if target == p.UserID, p is an owner, the new role is not owner, and p is the only owner, return 409 last_owner (the store's SetMemberRole check already covers this case). All other self-role changes stay 403. Add a case to TestLastOwner in internal/api/roles_test.go: the sole owner PATCHes their own role to member and expects 409 last_owner, while an owner with a co-owner present still gets 403.
